# View in Browser

`email/view-in-browser` &middot; section-level &middot; category: email

## Purpose

A small "View it in your browser" line using Klaviyo's web view link.

## Required fields

None.

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | text | `"Having trouble viewing this email?"` |
| `label` | text | `"View it in your browser"` |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Centered, muted, on the surface color.
- **page**: On the page background color, above the email card. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `linkColor` | color | `"@colors.mutedText"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.sm @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Plain text and a link, honored. | Fine. | Text and link swap via dm-* classes where honored. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('email/view-in-browser', {}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "email/view-in-browser",
  "data": {}
}
```
